steps.say: Place the blue base plate flat
steps.detail: Studs facing up, long side toward you.
steps.check: A blue rectangular Lego plate lies flat on the table with its studs facing up and nothing on it.

steps.say: Clip two axles under the base
steps.detail: One grey axle near each short end.
steps.check: The blue plate has two grey axle pieces attached underneath, one near each end.
common_mistakes: both axles at the same end

steps.detail: Black wheels, one on each axle end.
steps.check: Four black wheels are attached, two on each side of the blue plate.

steps.say: Add the red 2x4 at the back
steps.detail: Press it onto the 4 rear studs of the blue base.
steps.check: A red 2x4 brick sits on top of the rear half of the blue plate.

steps.say: Add the clear windscreen in front
steps.detail: Transparent sloped piece, slope facing forward.
steps.check: A transparent sloped piece sits on the front half of the blue plate, in front of the red brick.
common_mistakes: windscreen placed on the red brick

steps.say: Seat the driver behind the windscreen
steps.detail: Minifigure between the windscreen and the red brick.
steps.check: A Lego minifigure sits between the transparent windscreen and the red brick.
common_mistakes: driver placed on top of the red brick
